subject: chemistry
title: Exercises
textbookText: Exercises A. Multiple choice questions 1. Which of the following determines the major portion of atomic mass?
a. neutrons and protons b. electrons and protons c. electrons and neutrons d. neutrons and positrons
2. There are two isotopes of the same element. Which of the following is common? a. atomic weight b. chemical reactivity c. the number of neutrons d. the number of protons

3. Which of the following is true about compounds? a. Compounds are pure substances that are composed of two or more elements in a fixed proportion. b. Compounds cannot be broken down chemically to produce their constituent elements or other compounds. c. All the compounds are alike in structure and properties. d. Compounds are also called mixtures.

4. Which of the following is true about the symbol 17Cl35? a. 17 protons, 17 electrons, and 17 neutrons. b. 17 protons, 17 electrons, and 18 neutrons. c. 17 protons, 18 electrons, and 17 neutrons. d. 35 protons, 35 electrons, and 17 neutrons
5. Which of the following molecular formula contains the highest number of atoms?
a. KClO b. KClO2 c. KClO3 d. KClO4
6. Which of the following radicals has maximum valency?
a. Nitrate b. Nitrite c. Cyanide d. Sulphate
7. What is the approximate mass of 1 atomic mass unit?
a. Mass of 1 atom of carbon b. Mass of 1 atom of oxygen c. Mass of 1 atom of hydrogen d. Mass of 1 atom of chlorine
